spans.text: Gather information about what changed (from git log, PRs, or user description)
spans.note: The prompt emphasizes accuracy and factual grounding by instructing the agent to gather information from git logs, PRs, or user descriptions before writing. It also instructs the agent to focus on outcomes and avoid internal implementation details, which promotes honest, user-relevant communication rather than fabrication.
